d: You as a GIS Installation and commissioning Team Lead will be part of Hitachi Energy business based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. You will be focusing on providing technical advice to customers including commissioning, installing, and testing of products or equipment including Identifying and correcting more complex problems associated with start-up. Researching, evaluating, and recommending new products or equipment upgrades that will meet customer needs. Developing on-going relationships with customers to secure future business.
q: A bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
8+ years of experience in GIS preferred. GIS certification is a must.
Strong knowledge with SF6 GAS-Handling. PGHV Transmission and Sub transmission GIS Product knowledge preferred.
Proficiency in usage of MS project.
Proficiency in both spoken and written English and Arabic language is required.
